excerpt: With 6-ton of total Xenon and 4-ton sensitive target, PandaX-4T aims to improve the dark matter sensitivity by one order of magnitude. This project has been commissioned in 2021 and started data taking since then. ... the PandaX-4T detector at the PandaX Dark-Matter Laboratory, 2400 m underground at the Jinping site in Sichuan.
